title: Nsuyiri Kɛse no Ho Dawurubɔfo
intro: Saa onipa yi gyinaa hɔ sɛ boasetɔ odum mfehaha pii, na ɔfrɛɛ ɔmanfo a wɔyɛ asoɔden kɔɔ nokware hann mu bere a na wohyia fɛwdi ne pow no. Ɛmfa ho sɛ na ɔhaw ahorow a ɛboro so ne nkrasɛm bi mu duru a ɛfa awo ntoatoaso ahorow ho no, saa akoa yi kɔɔ so pintinn wɔ wɔn asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no mu kosii sɛ wɔde mmara a etwa to no mae.
clues: Mede mfe ahankron aduonum frɛɛ me nkurɔfo kɔɔ tenenee kwan no so, awia ne anadwo, wɔ kokoam ne baguam.
Mebɔɔ me nkurɔfo kɔkɔ wɔ asotwe a ɛyɛ yaw ho, nanso wɔde wɔn nsateaa guu wɔn aso mu de wɔn ntade kataa wɔn ho de ahantan.
Wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ mensi biribi kɛseɛ wɔ m’Awurade ani a ɛwɛn no ase, ɛwom mpo sɛ na nsuo biara nni hɔ a wɔbɛhunu de.
Bere a mereyɛ adwuma no, me nkurɔfo akannifo twaam na wodii me ho fɛw, nanso meka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ ɛrenkyɛ na yɛn na yɛadi wɔn ho fɛw.
Mesrɛɛ m’ankasa me honam ne mogya sɛ wɔmmɛka me ho, nanso wɔpaw sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ guankɔbea wɔ bepɔw bi so, a na wogye di sɛ ebegye wɔn afi asorɔkye a ɛrekɔ soro no mu.
Awiei koraa no, m’anwenne no bɛdaa Bepɔw Judi so bere a asase menee ne nsu na wim gyaee osu a ɛtɔ no.

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
